paras.en: I think he made his escape with the help of a migration of wild birds. On the morning he left, he put his planet in good order. He carefully swept out his active volcanoes. He owned two active volcanoes. And they were very handy for warming up his breakfast in the morning. He also owned an extinct volcano. But, as he used to say, “You never know!” So he swept out the extinct volcano too. If volcanoes are properly swept out, they burn gently and steadily, without erupting. Volcanic eruptions are like chimney fires. Of course, on our Earth we are far too small to sweep out our volcanoes. That is why they cause us so much trouble.
paras.zh: 我想，他是趁着野鸟迁徙的机会逃走的。出发那天早晨，他把自己的星球收拾得整整齐齐。他仔细清扫了自己的活火山。他有两座活火山。用来热早饭很方便。他还有一座死火山。不过，正如他常说的：“谁知道呢！”所以，他把那座死火山也清扫了一遍。火山只要清扫干净，就会缓缓地、均匀地燃烧，不会喷发。火山喷发就像烟囱着火。当然，在我们的地球上，我们实在太小了，没法清扫我们的火山。所以，它们才给我们惹出那么多麻烦。

paras.en: The little prince also pulled up the last baobab shoots, with a little sadness. He thought he would never return. But that morning, all these familiar tasks felt very sweet to him. And when he watered the flower one last time and prepared to shelter her under her glass globe, he found himself wanting to cry.
paras.zh: 小王子还带着一点忧伤，拔掉了最后几株猴面包树的嫩芽。他以为自己再也不会回来了。可那天早晨，这些熟悉的活儿在他心里都变得格外甜美。当他最后一次给花浇水，准备把她罩在玻璃罩下保护起来时，他发现自己想哭。

paras.en: But she did not answer him.
The flower coughed. But it was not because of her cold.
paras.zh: 花咳嗽了。但这不是因为她的感冒。

paras.en: “I have been foolish,” she told him at last. “Please forgive me. Try to be happy.”
paras.zh: “我以前太傻了，”她终于对他说，“请你原谅我。要努力让自己幸福。”

paras.en: He was surprised that she did not reproach him. He stood there quite bewildered, holding the globe in the air. He did not understand this quiet gentleness.
paras.zh: 她竟然没有责怪他，这让他很惊讶。他站在那里，不知所措，玻璃罩还举在半空。他不明白她怎么会这样平静而温柔。

paras.en: “Yes, I do love you,” the flower told him. “You never knew it, and that was my fault. It does not matter at all. But you have been just as foolish as I have. Try to be happy… Leave that globe alone. I do not want it any more.”
paras.zh: “是啊，我爱你，”花对他说，“你一直不知道，是我的错。这一点也不要紧。不过，你以前也和我一样傻。要努力让自己幸福……别管那个玻璃罩了。我不再要它了。”

paras.en: “My cold isn't that bad… The cool night air will do me good. I am a flower.”
paras.zh: “我的感冒没那么严重……夜里清凉的空气对我有好处。我是一朵花。”

paras.en: “I'll have to put up with two or three caterpillars if I want to get to know the butterflies. They say they're so beautiful. Otherwise, who will visit me? You—you'll be far away. As for the big animals, I have nothing to fear. I have my claws.”
paras.zh: “我要是想认识蝴蝶，总得忍受两三条毛毛虫。听说蝴蝶美极了。不然谁会来看我呢？你呀，你会在很远的地方。至于那些大动物，我没什么好怕的。我有我的爪子。”

paras.en: And she innocently showed her four thorns. Then she added:
paras.zh: 而她天真地展示着自己的四根刺。接着她又说：

paras.en: “Don't linger like that. It's annoying. You've decided to leave. Go away.”
paras.zh: “别这么磨蹭了，真叫人心烦。你已经决定要走了。走吧。”

paras.en: For she did not want him to see her cry. She was such a proud flower…
paras.zh: 因为她不想让他看见她哭。她是一朵那么骄傲的花……
